answer: The increase is in 노즐 막힘 (nozzle clogging) stops. Monthly count was 10/8/5 in Mar-May, then 16 in Jun, 23 in Jul, 22 in Aug; the downtime minutes for this cause rose from about 220 in May to about 770 in Jun and about 1,440 in Jul (about 1,160 in Aug). Total stops rose from 32 in May to 52 (Jun), 64 (Jul) and 65 (Aug). The rise starts in June. It affects all four reactors: R4 went 1 to 5 to 5 to 9 and R3 peaked at 9 in July. Power (전력) stops also reappeared from July (0 in May-Jun, 8 per month in Jul-Aug). Catalyst feed, heater and other causes are roughly flat.
